prompt:
A single mobile web page screen, portrait, 1024x1536, rendered edge to edge as the page itself (no phone frame, no browser chrome). "Oozedle": a daily game for the college ultimate team Ooze; it hides one player's stat line from one tournament; six guesses; each guess shows only an up arrow (hidden player had more), down arrow (fewer) or equals sign per stat. A working game screen of standard web controls.

Regions, top to bottom:
1. A full-width solid ink-black header band, the page's one dominant move: the wordmark "OOZEDLE" small in white at top-left, links "Players" and "Tournaments" small in white at top-right; below them, filling the band's width, the puzzle number "214" reversed out in white at enormous size in the heavy condensed face, like the number on a field sign; along the band's bottom edge in one line: "PDQ · 2026" in marker orange and "Tue Oct 21 · Name the player in 6" in white.
2. The guess board on white stock: column heads "Player", "PP", "A", "G", "B", "T" in the condensed face, a heavy black rule under them. Rows ruled like bracket lines:
   1 Rowan (struck through): PP up, A down, G up, B down, T equals
   2 Farmer (struck through): PP down, A equals, G up, B down, T up
   3 Colin (struck through): PP up, A down, G equals, B equals, T down
   4, 5, 6: empty rows, row 4's number in orange as the current row.
3. A full-width guess bar pinned to the bottom of the screen: a text input "Guess a player" spanning most of the width with the autocomplete list open above it showing three matching names "Hugo", "Henry", "Ian" as plain rows; a marker-orange "Guess" button at the right end of the bar.

Visual world (fixed): the laminated schedule and bracket sheet zip-tied to the fence at a college ultimate tournament, translated into a clean, flat web screen. Ground is white board stock #f6f5f0; ink #141414; one marker-orange accent #ff5a1f used sparingly; thin rules #d9d7cf and heavy black bracket rules. One heavy condensed grotesk numeral/display face does every job from giant numbers to table heads; body text in a plain grotesk. Arrows are heavy black glyphs; equals cells are solid ink blocks with a white "="; wrong-guess names are struck through, never removed. No textures, no zip ties drawn, no shadows, no gradients, no photos, no mascots.
